name: WebGL Release
notes: Builds go through manage_build; manage_editor has no build action. The `target` field above is Unity's BuildTarget name, while manage_build's `target` param takes the bridge alias (`webgl`) -- see bridgeCall. IL2CPP is the only backend for Web; `scripting_backend` accepts only `mono` or `il2cpp` and there is no `coreclr` value. The `options` array accepts only clean_build, auto_run, deep_profiling, compress_lz4, strict_mode and detailed_report -- `Lz4HC` is NOT in that vocabulary and must be set in Build Settings or a Build Profile. Threading on Unity 6.4: multithreaded RENDERING is still unavailable, but [BurstCompile] jobs do run on background workers for Web builds; non-Burst jobs stay on the main thread. Expect long build times and respect the browser memory ceiling. Source: https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/whats-new/unity64, retrieved 2026-10-21.
